title: Plan my cruise
standfirst: Tell us when you'd like to sail, for how long and who is coming. Operators whose cruises fit can send you personal offers, and you choose.

faqs.q: Do I need an account to plan?
faqs.a: No. Your plan stays on this device while you work on it. You sign in or create an account only to send it, so operators can reply to you.

faqs.q: Does a plan commit me to anything?
faqs.a: No. Operators send offers; nothing is booked until you accept one, and nothing is paid until then.
Operators whose cruises fit your dates and route can reply as soon as they see your request. We email you when an offer arrives.

seoDescription: Plan a Nile cruise in a minute: dates, nights, guests and budget. Operators whose cruises fit send you personal offers.
